citations.A1: Module-level `_cache` never invalidates once set — fix: re-read when the file's mtime/hash changes, not just when `_cache is None`.
citations.A2: Tempting fix "add a TTL / periodic cache clear" would NOT properly address it — it papers over staleness with a delay instead of detecting the actual change
citations.A3: "just remove `if _cache is None` and always read" would work but reintroduces a disk read on every call with no benefit of caching — not root-cause-wrong, but defeats the purpose of caching at all.
citations.A4: Caching keyed by nothing (global, ignores `path` argument) — fix: key the cache by resolved path so different configs don't collide.
citations.A5: No thread safety — fix: guard cache read/write with a lock if `get_config` is called from multiple threads (mtime check + reload isn't atomic otherwise).
